description: Frequency floor per sublevel, checked by scripts/check-coverage.mjs. By the end of a sublevel, the vocabulary taught so far must hold at least minShare of the topRank most frequent lemmas of data/lemma/de-frequency.tsv. The rest of a band is theme words. minShareBySublevel overrides minShare for one sublevel: the B2 and C1 floors are 70% on purpose, because the path is expected to grow toward about rank 8000 by C1.2 in a later step, so these floors are a minimum, not the target. minTextCoverage is the north star's 95% rule applied to the German text of the spec itself.
